# OLYMPUS v0.0.7, "The line at 300 m": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-07 for the round's five implementers (ballistics, body, range, stage, hud) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then the sections); my own choices are marked (my call) and every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.7 row, shipped as v0.0.7: `test-range`, "The line at 300 m" (`?play=test-range`, the Tests menu's "The line at 300 m"). The KD range in full at its final place outside the East gate (PLACES §4.12, X3), firing east, the v0.0.5 25 m bay beside it: zero at 25 m, confirm at 300 m with the pits marking each shot, the pits skipped behind their splash, a string at 200 m sitting, rapid, ten rounds with a magazine change, the coach's dummy round, the relay firing beside you, "No brass, no ammo" at the declaration, the score card. It is the line's part of ROADMAP §4.4's moment 3 ("Clear at the window"); the window, the bus and cleaning are 0.0.8's.

**What the user must feel.** The shot at 300 m is earned: the zero you set, the wind you read off the flags and the coach's call, the hold, your position and breath, the d20 against its DC with every term on the plaque (tradecraft's), and you see it land: the far window on your face, the target going down into the pits and coming up with a spotter in the hole and the score disk on its pole. The relay is alive (generated marines firing their own strings with their own rolls, reports and brass). The range is a disciplined place (the tower, the cold line, the muzzle, cease fire, the declaration). The pace is a game's: long waits behind the splash, the course about six real minutes, short enough to replay. Never a dead end.

**The user's rules hold over every section**: places authored, what happens on them procedural (named rng streams from the world's seed); every person generated; 16 px/m chibi (`?ppm=24` a test density only); every picture and sound made by code; nothing pops in view; no fast travel; no abstraction where an action could be lived; graphics over words, no overlapping UI; AZERTY labels on physical codes. v0.0.6's lessons (DESIGN.md's log, 2026-11-07): a scene never dead-ends (the coach's dry check, the 60 s move-on), one magazine a string (this course's one written exception, §8 item 11), reach for a magazine and see what it holds, kinds of rounds. **test-handling was scored 100/100/100 ★ and must not get worse**: its course by the range bot stays the same to the tick, the point and the coach's words (§3.3). COMBAT §25 is 0.0.7b's: nothing here builds the take-in or rungs, nothing contradicts them (§8 item 27).

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1); a change in a file you do not own goes in your report as the exact edit; no commits, branches, tags, pushes, `release.sh` or `promote.sh`; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul`, `../tradecraft` (read freely, import their pure modules from a scratch script under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r7/<role>/` for numbers) or `docs/research/`; scratch under that folder. **Ports**: ballistics 8231, body 8232, range 8233, stage 8234, hud 8235; the integrator 8236; reviews 8237 to 8239; `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for `tests/browser.mjs`; kill every server. Tests: `node tests/run.mjs '<file> ›'` for your suites, `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` for everything quick; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, printed. Look at what you build (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m). Docs and CHANGELOG.md are the lead's: return CHANGELOG bullets and doc items (file, section, exact change).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes §2's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: ballistics, body, range, stage, hud; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each. **A gunless game and test-handling change only where §3.3 says.**

## 2. Interfaces

JavaScript signatures; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, times integer game ms; positions in the area's frame (x east, z south, y up, metres); a face's coordinates in cm from its centre, **x right and y down** as the stage draws paper (v0.0.5's convention). Pure unless marked **w**.

### 2.1 ballistics

**The flight** (`ballistics.js`; WEAPONS §2.1, §2.5, §2.7):

```js
ENV_CLASSES = { earth, 'mars-valley', 'mars-datum', 'ship-thrust', 'ship-light', 'freefall-air', 'earth-ship', europa, 'freefall-vacuum' }
  // each { gMs2, pKpa, airC, molarKgMol, vacuum }: WEAPONS §2.1's table (Mars air 0.02962, Earth 0.02896 kg/mol)
envOfPlace(state, area, x, z) → env          // the range: body.js envOf({ outdoors: true }): 65.9 kPa, −10 °C, 0.38 g: 'mars-valley'
airOf(env) → { rhoKgM3, soundMs }            // ρ = P M / (R T), c = √(1.4 R T / M); vacuum: { 0, 0 }
soundMsOf(env) → m/s                         // the hud's delays (0 in vacuum)
boreTable(cal, load, barrelMm) → { stepM: 5, maxM, at(rhoKgM3, soundMs, v0K, rangeM) → { tofS, vMs, dS2 } }
  // built at first use, cached per (cal, load, barrel); G7 point mass on WEAPONS §2.1's grid (ρ 0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 1.25;
  // c 310, 345; v0 × 0.92, 1.00, 1.08); trilinear, D × v0² and t × v0 across v0; nothing allocated per call
zeroOf(cal, load, barrelMm, env, rangeM) → { rangeM, gMs2, rhoKgM3, soundMs, v0Ms, angleMrad }   // WEAPONS §2.5's record
BZO → zeroOf('6.5x40r', 'ball', 460, ENV_CLASSES['mars-valley'], BZO_M)                         // the Corps' battle-sight zero
flight(cal, load, barrelMm, env, rangeM, { zero = BZO, crossMs = 0, v0K = 1 }) →
  { rangeM, tofS, vMs, eJ, pathCm, dropCm, driftCm, penMm, supersonic, mach }
  // pathCm: the round against the line of sight for that zero (+ high), the optic OPTIC_H_M over the bore;
  // driftCm: + toward the crosswind's way (Didion: crossMs × (t − d / v0)); penMm: pen0 × (v / v0)^penExp
dopeOf(model, load, env, rangeM, zero = BZO) → { elev: clicks, wind: 0 }   // the clicks from the zero that put the path at 0
DOPE_CARD = { r7: { 200: { elev }, 300: { elev }, 500: { elev } } }       // dopeOf at load for the valley floor; what the Corps prints
ZERO25_MARK_CM                                                            // flight(…, 25).pathCm, as the zero card prints it (≈ −3)
woundFactor({ eJ, diaMm, woundK }) → w                                    // WEAPONS §8.1: (E/500)^0.36 × (dia/9)^0.3 × woundK
```

**The wind** (`wind.js`; WEAPONS §7.4, §11.1; PLACES §4.12: "Wind is the weather's at the line"; my call: a closed form of the seed, the sol and the time, no state, until PLACES's weather; §8 item 5):

```js
windAt(seed, ms, x, z) → { towardRad, speedMs, gustK }   // pure; the day's mean (stream('wind', seed, sol)) × slow drift × gust,
                                                         // the gust's phase lagged by the distance along the wind over the mean speed
crossOf(wind, bearingRad) → m/s                          // the component across a bearing; + pushes the round to the shooter's right
pathWind(seed, ms, from, to) → { crossMs, headMs }       // the mean of WIND_SAMPLES 5 points from the muzzle to the face, at ms
flagOf(seed, ms, x, z) → { towardRad, liftK }            // liftK 0 limp to 1 straight out (FLAG_FULL_MS); the stage's, through look.js
windCorrOf(mrk, { coach = false }) → 0..0.95             // clamp((MRK − 6)/24, 0, 0.8), + COACH_CORR 0.2 with a coach's call
readWind(state, pid, { atMs, bearingRad, coach = false }) →
  { crossMs, band: [lo, hi], speedWord, fromWord, atMs }
  // the shooter's belief (WEAPONS §7.4): crossEst = mean cross over READ_AVG_S 10 s before atMs (gusts not in it) × (1 + e),
  // e uniform in ±(1 − windCorr), on stream('judge', seed, pid, 'wind', atMs); never the truth; the coach's on his own sheet
```

**The sight and the zero** (`firearms.js`, `models.js`; WEAPONS §2.5, §3.5, §11.4). The gun's truth gains `sight: { elev, wind }` (the turrets' settings, integer clicks, `CLICK_MRAD` 0.1 each, ±`TURRET_MAX_CLK` 60; up raises the strike, right moves it right), `zero: { elev, wind }` (the settings at which this rifle strikes on the Corps' BZO: drawn at issue, never shown) and `optic: 1 | 4` (the SO-4's lever). The belief gains `zero: { elev, wind } | null` (what the holder believes the zero is: the armoury card's at issue, the coach's after a zero). The turrets and the lever are seen, so `beliefOf` returns them as they are. `GUN_DEFAULTS` gains `sight: null` (0, 0), `zero: null` (0, 0), `optic: 1`, so a v0.0.6 gun reads zeroed on the BZO at 1× and saves byte for byte.

```js
beliefOf(state, gunId) → { …v0.0.6, sight: { elev, wind }, zero: { elev, wind } | null, optic, dope: { 200, 300, 500: { elev, wind } } | null }
  // dope = belief.zero + DOPE_CARD (believed only; null with no believed zero)
ACTIONS += dial (DIAL_S a click × pace, no roll, hands off: resets the held aim), optic (OPTIC_S, no roll), read (READ_S × pace, no roll)
drawZero(seed, gunId) → { elev, wind }    // N(0, ZERO_SD_CLK) clamped ±ZERO_MAX_CLK on stream('zero', seed, gunId): the rifle as the armoury hands it out
```

**The shot at distance** (`shot.js`; WEAPONS §7.2 to §7.4, §7.10). The DC is `dcOf` as now, the face's `targetDC` its term. The modifiers gain the sitting position (`POSITION.sit` +3, "sitting") and the SO-4 at its lever (`opticMod(gun.optic, d)`). **On a KD face or the zero card the bias moves the hole in centimetres and is not a modifier** (§8 item 2); on a person it is WEAPONS §7.4's `biasMod` with the character's own corrections (no person is shot at this round, but the helper and its table are built and tested).

```js
biasMod(biasCm, partRadiusCm) → −round(5 × log2(1 + |bias| / r))
poiOf(state, pid, gunId, target, { ms, belief = false }) → { elevCm, windCm, terms: [{ key, why, cm }] }
  // the strike against the point of aim at the face, cm (y down), as the truth or as the shooter believes it:
  //   zero   (sight − zero) × CLICK_MRAD × d / 10, each axis (belief: sight − belief.zero)
  //   path   flight(…).pathCm for the BZO in the place's air (the dope card's, believed exactly: the Corps prints it)
  //   wind   flight(…, { crossMs }).driftCm: the truth pathWind at ms; the belief readWind's (or the coach's call, the later of the two)
  //   hold   the reticle's hold (stop.hold, mrad) × d / 10, moving the point of aim, so the strike the other way
  // terms keyed 'zero' | 'path' | 'wind' | 'hold' for the plaque and the log
plaqueOf(state, pid, { target, … }) → { …v0.0.6, terms: [{ key: 'range' | 'wind' | 'hold' | 'zero', words, v }], kd: null | {
    aimCm, poiCm: [x, y] (believed), holdMil: [x, y], scoreOdds, ringOdds: { v, 5, 4, 3, 2, miss } } }
  // on a face `odds` is the chance of a scoring hit (a 2 or better) on the believed strike (paper.js faceOdds), a
  // percentage on a known line (the distance known) when the wind read's band moves it under 10 points, else SKILLS §5.11's words
resolveShot(…) → { ms, shot }   // shot += { face: { paper, lane, line } | null, aimCm, poiCm: { elevCm, windCm, terms } (true),
  //   hole: { at: [xCm, yCm] | null, score, v, onPaper, band }, flight: { rangeM, tofS, vMs, eJ, supersonic }, crossMs (true) }
  // the roll's log line lists the true terms with the shooter's belief beside them (WEAPONS §7.10):
  // "… = 31 against 20 (300 m 25, the A target −11, the R-7 0, base 6). A 4, high left: wind 4.6 m/s (you read 3), held 0.5 mil."
```

**Faces and scoring** (`paper.js`; WEAPONS §11.1, §11.4). `card25` is untouched: its hole stays the margin's ring by hash (test-handling, §3.3). The new papers place a hole in real units:

```js
PAPERS += zero25 { word: 'the 25 m zeroing card', targetDC: 6, sizeCm: [30, 30], ringCm: 2.5, kind: 'zero', markCm: [0, −ZERO25_MARK_CM], gridCm: 1 },
          kdA    { word: 'the A target', targetDC: −11, sizeCm: [100, 100], ringCm: 7.5, kind: 'kd', biasRadiusCm: 30, blackCm: 15 },
          kdB    { word: 'the B target', targetDC: −13, sizeCm: [120, 120], ringCm: 11.25, kind: 'kd', biasRadiusCm: 45, blackCm: 22.5 }
faceHole(paperId, { aimCm, poiCm, roll, shotId, seed }) → { at, score, v, onPaper, band }
  // the group's spread is the roll's: holeOf's band by the margin and its hashed angle and radius in ring widths (a nat 1:
  // MISS_BAND 4 to 6 ring widths), then moved by aim + poi; scored by ringAt on where it lands; at null only off the paper
ringAt(paperId, [x, y]) → { score, v, band }    // radius from the face's centre: V ≤ 0.5 w, 5 ≤ 1 w, 4 ≤ 2 w, 3 ≤ 3 w, 2 ≤ 4 w, else 0
faceOdds(paperId, { value, dc, mods, poiCm }) → { score: P(2 or better), rings: { v, 5, 4, 3, 2, miss } }
  // each d20 face's band, its radius and angle on a fixed 8 × 32 quadrature, cached on (paper, value + Σmods − dc, poi to 0.5 cm)
groupOf(holes) → { n, centreCm: [x, y], spreadCm }
callOf(paperId, centreCm, rangeM, { targetCm = paper.markCm ?? [0, 0] }) → { elev, wind, words }
  // clicks to move the group's centre onto the target point: round(−Δ / (CLICK_MRAD × d / 10)); y down, so a low group dials up
scoreOf(holes)  // as v0.0.5 (shots, hits, score, of, v, groupCm), holes now { at, score, v }
```

**Penetration** (`penetrate.js`; WEAPONS §8.2 to §8.7; tradecraft's `armour.js` adapted: `layerHit`, `centreOf`, `BLUNT`, `WEAR`, the helmet's dome; its per-calibre `STOP` table becomes the pen-and-rating logistic):

```js
MATERIALS = { paper, regolith, berm, concrete, steelMild, steelArmour, aluminium, … }   // WEAPONS §8.5: { pPerMm, hard }; berm and regolith: stop all
TISSUE_P = { torso: 1.6, limb: 0.8, head: 1.4 }
penOf(cal, load, vMs) → mm RHAe;  pStop(penMm, pEff) → 0..1;  after(vMs, penMm, pEff) → vMs
layerHit(person, r, centre) → 'plate' | 'soft' | 'bare'                // tradecraft's, as WEAPONS §8.3
traceRound(state, { shooterId, from: { x, y, z }, yawRad, pitchRad, cal, load, barrelMm, env, maxM, rngKey, margin = 0, nd = false }) →
  { path: [{ x, y, z }], stoppedBy: { kind: 'berm' | 'ground' | 'parapet' | 'body' | 'past', at, id? },
    hits: [HitRecord], faces: [{ lane, at: [xCm, yCm] }], nearMisses: [{ who, passM, crack }] }
  // along the line through the live area: a body whose height span the line crosses within BODY_R_M 0.25 m is hit (the part by the
  // line's height on the span: legs to 45%, torso to 85%, head above; a prone body along its length), within
  // STRAY_M 0.35 m at STRAY_HIT 0.25 (tradecraft's STRAY); tissue per §8.4 (exit when pen > P × U(0.7, 1.3)); a face is paper
  // (holed, never stops); the ground, the parapet and the berm stop it; every draw on stream('pen', seed, rngKey)
hitOf({ onId, part, fromId, rangeM, cal, load, vMs, margin, shotId, through, exitPart, armour }) → HitRecord   // WEAPONS §8.7's
holeArea(load, layer) → [{ areaMm2, kind }]                            // WEAPONS §8.6, for later readers; tested now
```

`HitRecord` is WEAPONS §8.7's JSON with `nd: true | false` and `w` from `woundFactor`. penetrate.js never writes the body: it returns hits, and the caller hands each to `applyHit` (§2.2).

**Targets, the far point and the steps** (`shooting.js`):

```js
targetsOf(state, pid) → [ …v0.0.5's, { key: 'face:<lane>', kind: 'paper', paper: 'kdA', x, z, y, dM, lane, line, name: 'your target' | 'target <n>', far: true } ]
  // on a KD line (kdLineOf(state, pid) ≠ null), the faces of the lanes in sight from it (the 20; aiming another lane's is
  // range safety's warning), a far one in the list though outside the frame: the far window counts as the frame (VIEWS §2.4)
farPointOf(state, pid = playerId(state), { looking = false } = {}) → null | { key, x, y, z, rangeM, lane, line, why: 'aim' | 'bracket' | 'look', label: 'TARGET 10 · 300 M' }
  // the aimed, else the bracketed, else (looking: E held, which main.js passes) your own lane's face, when outside the lead's frame
STEP ids += 'sight:elev:<±n>', 'sight:wind:<±n>', 'sight:dope:<line>', 'sight:call' (the coach's pending call),
            'hold:<xMil>,<yMil>', 'hold:read', 'hold:call', 'hold:centre', 'read', 'optic:1', 'optic:4', 'stance:sit'
state.stop.hold = { xMil, yMil }   // absent: centre; HOLD_STEP_MRAD steps within ±HOLD_MAX_MRAD; a change costs HOLD_SHIFT_MS, keeps the held aim
```

Each new row in `stepsOf` carries `{ id, label, ms, skill: null, odds: null, words }` as v0.0.5's rows do: "Dial the coach's call: 4 up, 2 left · 1.6 s", "Dope for 300 m: 3 down · 0.4 s", "Hold for your read: 0.5 mil right", "Hold for the coach: 0.75 mil right", "Read the flags · 1.5 s", "Four power · 0.5 s", "Sitting · 2.0 s". `stance:sit` is offered by its own row (never in A and W's cycle, which stays stand, kneel, prone). The rows `sight:dope` and `hold:*` appear only on a KD line or the zero card's line.

### 2.2 body

**The wound model** (`wounds.js`; BODY §17.1 with its four changes, §17.2, §21, §22): tradecraft's `health.js` (404) and the pain of its `medicine.js`, on the body record (§3):

```js
PARTS = { head: 6, torso: 12, armL: 8, armR: 8, legL: 9, legR: 9 }      // points, × (1 + Fitness / FITNESS_K 20)
takes(rec, part, fitness);  stateOf(rec, part, fitness) → 'unhurt' | 'bruised' | 'hurt' | 'wounded' | 'out'
applyHit(state, bus, hit) → { injuries: [Injury], down: bool, dead: bool, knockS, words }     // w; the intake penetrate.js's caller calls
  // tradecraft's bullet(): points BULLET 7 × hit.w × U(0.8, 1.25); the part from hit.part (legs → legL | legR, a torso
  // to an arm 0.15 × (1 − clamp(margin/10, 0, 1)) of the time: WEAPONS §7.7); injure(): a gunshot cut, deep, its rate
  // (1 + 8 × force) × bleedK (TORSO 0.6, LIMB 0.9 × min(1.6, w)), a limb's capped at LIMB_CAP_PM 8 (BODY change 1), an artery
  // ARTERY_CHANCE + 0.2 × force (10 to 15 %/min); hit.through from penetrate.js (not tradecraft's EXIT_P); the chest's inside
  // bleed; the head's kill (HEAD_KILL 0.6 × max(1, w)) or graze; the knock (KNOCK_S by part, × pain and blood, × TRAINED_K
  // 0.4 for a marine); every draw on stream('wound', seed, onId, hit.shotId); emits 'wound', and 'body-dead' on a death
bleedRate(rec, ms, { exertion, pressed }) → %/min      // EXERTION, PRESSURE 0.35, BODY change 3's cold ×1.25 / ×1.5
bloodAt(rec, ms) → %                                   // the closed form: piecewise linear over each injury's bleed window, regeneration
                                                       // REGEN_PER_H 2 when nothing bleeds; the same lived and skipped
stepWounds(rec, fromMs, toMs, ctx) → rec               // w; the slow layer's step and a skip's: blood, the ends of bleeds, the knock's end, death
painOf(rec, ms) → points;  painBand(points) → null | { word, v }     // tradecraft's bands 25 / 45 / 70
avpuOf(rec, ms) → 'A' | 'V' | 'P' | 'U'                // BODY §17.2: blood < 55 U; 55 to 60 while bleeding P; head out U; the knock
canStand(rec, ms);  downOf(rec, ms) → { down, untilMs, why }
woundMods(rec, key, ms) → [{ why, v, src: 'body' }]    // tradecraft's mods(): a hurt arm −1, wounded −3, broken −6 to 'weapons' and
                                                       // 'marksmanship'; pain's band; pale −1, shock −3; a hurt head; through bodyMods
woundWords(rec, ms) → [string]                         // C and the instinct: "A gunshot wound in the left thigh, bleeding hard." never a number
careOf(rec, ms, { tier: 'corpsman' }) → rec            // w; the corpsman's care as a closed form (no steps until the lane, 0.1.x):
                                                       // a limb's bleed stopped (a tourniquet), a torso's pressed (×0.35), the inside's unchanged
casualtyOutcome(rec, { fromMs, evacMs = EVAC_MIN × 60,000 }) → { outcome: 'stabilised' | 'evacuated' | 'dead', atMs, bloodPct, words }
```

The body domain steps `stepWounds` in its slow contributor (every minute lived, every skip step) and the fast `bodyFast` reads `downOf` for the actor's stance (a casualty lies, `stance: 'down'`). An unwounded body runs none of it (no `injuries`, nothing to step), so every need's parity stands.

**Blood** (`blood.js`; tradecraft's `blood.js` 47 and its render's 62):

```js
spatter(state, { area, x, z, dx, n, who, atMs })   // w; places.sites[site].blood: [{ x, z, dx, n, seed, atMs }], the last BLOOD_DECALS_MAX 120
dripStep(state, ms)                               // w; a drip under each bleeding actor every DRIP_S [3, 7] s (seeded)
bloodLook(state, area, ms) → { decals: [{ x, z, dx, n, seed, atMs }], marks: { [actorId]: [{ part, atMs }] } }   // pure; SIM_FOR_VIEW
```

`RANGE_PIECES` gains, with `RANGE_KINDS` (sim) and the kit's `FOOTPRINTS` (stage) equal, pinned by `places-validate`: `kdCarrier` (1.8 × 0.3 × 2.0 m, a steel frame on rails: the face rides it), `kdParapet` (stretched, 0.5 m above the floor), `kdPits` (the trench: a floor piece, not a blocker), `kdBerm` (28 × 100 × 8 m, stretched), `kdFlag` (a pole 4.5 m with a sleeve: the cloth is the stage's), `kdPoint` (a numbered stake per lane per line, 0.1 × 0.1 × 0.6 m, `look.text` the lane), `kdLineBoard` (the line's distance board: "200", "300", "500"), `kdCanopy` (the ammunition point, 6 × 4 m, open), `rangeShack` (12 × 8 m, shut this round). The pads under each line are path surfaces as `LINE_PAD`. **The gates stay shut**: the KD is reached only by its scenes.

**The course** (`courses.js`): `COURSES.kd` and `SEQ_KD`, each command `{ id, ready, say: [≥ 2], stage, line?, string? }` as v0.0.5's (§4 gives the sequence). New readinesses: `zeroRead` (the coach has read the group), `dialled` (the coach's call dialled, or nothing called), `optic4`, `dope` (the turrets at the believed dope for the line), `sit1` (sitting, Condition 1 on safe), `policed`, `turnedIn` (no rounds on you), `declared`; `NEEDS_ROUNDS` gains `sit1`. A string may carry `mags: 2` (the 200 m string's written exception to one magazine a string, §8 item 11) and `limitS` (60: the tower's CEASE FIRE at the limit, lived time only).

**The scene** (`src/sim/scenarios/range.js`; `handling.js` generalised for it):

```js
RANGE = { site: 'melas', area: KD_RANGE.area, course: 'kd' }
testRange(state, { at = null, setup = null } = {})   // w; the fill: the barracks drawn, 10:00, the player on bay lane L
  // (drawLane, 2 to 5), the relay of RELAY_N 6 (you and five of your platoon, by stream(seed, 'range:relay')) on the bay's six

  // 'far' (the range-far bench: the 300 m line, prone, 4×, aimed at your face, Fire alone, the relay firing a long string)
kdLane(state) → 7..12          // KD lane = 6 + bay lane: the relay keeps its order (§8 item 10)
onPitEvent(state, bus, ev)     // w; the queue's 'pit' events (kind 'pit', prio 3, src 'arms:pits'): a carrier down, marked, up, the disk
kdNow(state, ms) → { stage, line, cmd, hot, limitMsLeft, groups: [{ holes, centreCm, call, ok }], zeroed,
  strings: [{ id, line, paper, holes: [{ at, score, v, n }], score, of, v }], pits: { [lane]: PitView }, call: CoachCall | null,
  relay: [{ who, name, lane, score, of, v }], brass: { fired, policed, left }, rounds: { held, turnedIn }, declared, casualty, summary }
  // the hud's and the bots' view; summary the end card's: "Clear at 10:31 · zero in 2 groups · 300 m 21 of 25 · 200 m 44 of 50 · 2 V · no faults"
```

**Activities** (TIME's records, taken; each with ≥ 4 log lines in TIME §8.8's voice): `kd-walk` (outcome engine, `where` the next line's ready point; at its end the player, the relay and the coach at their points facing downrange, the line's issue in the pouches), `kd-pits` (outcome, `PITS_MIN`: relay 2's confirm by `skipString`, its lines in the strip, then the walk to the 200 m line and its issue), `police-brass` (lived at the point, kneeling, `POLICE_CASE_S` a case; behind its splash over 45 s; effect `police`), `kd-casualty` (outcome, `EVAC_MIN`: the casualty taken off; its strip the outcome's words). Each is started by the scene, never offered by R.

```js
forceNd(state, bus, { pid, gunId = gunOn(state, pid), toward = null })   // w; tests' and the debug handle's: an ND from pid's rifle now,
                                                                         // its line toward a person id or { x, z } (unspread), graded and answered as any
```

`rangeNow` (v0.0.5) keeps its shape for test-handling; on the KD course it returns `kdNow`'s `summary` in its place so the end card reads either.

**The pits** (lived, in the session; WEAPONS §11.5 with this round's cut, §8 item 12). A fired shot at a face posts, at `tofS` + `PIT_REACT_S` (drawn), the carrier going down (`CARRIER_S`), the hole found (the puller's Awareness against `MARK_DC` 6, +3 in the black, +2 with a hole within 5 cm; the grade sets `MARK_S`), the spotter put in it, the carrier up, the score disk on its pole for `DISK_S` (a miss: the red flag, `FLAG_S`). A rapid string's targets stay up and are marked together after CEASE FIRE (`RAPID_MARK_S`). **Marks are true this round** (no mismark, no challenge: qual.js's, later). `PitView = { up: 0..1, phase: 'up' | 'down' | 'marking' | 'rising', spotter: [xCm, yCm] | null, disk: { value, untilMs } | null, flagUntilMs, holes: [{ at, score, n }] }`; `up` moves continuously over `CARRIER_S` (never a pop).

**The relay** (`gunner.js`; tradecraft's `armed.js` `gunner()` adapted: one step after another, each the player's own action, time and roll):

```js
newGunner(state, { pid, lane, line, gunId }) → Gunner          // w; into R.relay
gunnerStep(state, bus)                                         // w; the 'actors' fast layer, live only: each gunner whose untilMs has
  // come does its next step for the tower's current command: walk to the point (a path, the gait), the stance (its transition),
  // the macros (doAction / runMacro with its own roller: LOAD, MAKE READY, the RELOADs, IMMEDIATE ACTION on a stoppage, UNLOAD
  // SHOW CLEAR), the dope dialled, its own wind read and hold (holdFor: the read, never the truth), the aim (aimMsOf), the hold to
  // +4 in slow fire and to +2 in rapid, the pull (resolveShot at its face: its own stream, roll, hole, brass), the wait for its
  // mark; on CEASE FIRE it stops at the sub-step's end and goes on safe; its stoppages, fumbles and NDs are the ladder's, as yours
relayReady(state, cmdId) → bool                                // every gunner ready for the RO's next command (lineReady reads it)
skipString(state, pid, { line, paper, rounds, position, rapid }) → { shots, score, of, v }   // w; a string rolled shot by shot at the
                                                               // string's start modifiers (WEAPONS §11.3), for relay 2 behind the pits' splash
```

A gunner is `{ pid, aid, lane, gunId, magIds, untilMs, step, hold: [x, y], read: { crossMs, atMs } | null, zero: { elev, wind } | null, shots, score, of, v }` (§3). Gunners do not use `takeInMs` (COMBAT §25's, 0.0.7b): they answer the tower, nothing else (§8 item 27). Their rolls are not written to J (the log is yours); their shots are `shot` facts with their `who`.

**Brass** (`brass.js`; WEAPONS §2.8, §10.4): a case at rest leaves `R.brass` (the 64 live) for `R.brassTiles` (`{ '<ix>,<iz>': { n, mine } }` on 1 m tiles of the area, `mine` the player's count), so every case of the relay stays drawn and counted. `brassNear(state, pid, m = POLICE_M)` → `{ n, mine }`; `police(state, pid)` (w) picks up the player's within `POLICE_M` (the `police-brass` activity's effect).

**The casualty on the line** (range.js with the body's helpers; WEAPONS §6.6, BODY §27; §8 item 15). An ND's `ndOf` traces the line (`traceRound`) and hands each hit to `applyHit`; a person hit is **ND-4**, a death **ND-5**. The line answers: the RO's "CEASE FIRE! CEASE FIRE!" (every gunner on safe), the coach takes the shooter's rifle (v0.0.5's stop, without ending the scene), the corpsman (a generated person, post `melas:kd-corpsman`) runs to the casualty (a path at the run) and works beside them `CARE_EDGE_S` lived (kneeling; `careOf` applied as he starts), then an outcome splash (`kd-casualty`, outcome engine, `EVAC_MIN`): `casualtyOutcome` decides stabilised, evacuated or dead, said in the splash's strip and on the card; then "The range is closed." and UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR, the declaration, the end card with the incident ("Range closed: Pvt Okafor hit in the left thigh by a negligent discharge, evacuated"). **If the casualty is the player**, the knock lays them down, the corpsman comes, and the splash carries them to the aid station's outcome; the card says so ("You were hit in the left foot: evacuated to the aid station").

**Range safety in full** (range.js `safety()`, tradecraft's `scenarios/range.js` 415 adapted over v0.0.5's `rangeSafety` verdicts): every rule of WEAPONS §6.4 as built, on every line's boxes (`kd.lanes[].points[line].box`), for the player and checked for gunners (who never break them but by an ND), plus: **the cold line** (a muzzle in hand off safe, or the finger in, while the tower has the line cold: a warning; a round fired: v0.0.5's warning then stop), **forward of the line while hot** (any person past the firing line's x while hot: the stop, "Cease fire! Get back behind the line!"; the pits are behind the parapet and never count), **the muzzle over people** (the cone over a neighbour or the coach: v0.0.5's flag warning; aimed: the stop), **cease fire** (the tower's, or any shooter's "Cease fire" on an ND: every rifle stopped), **the ND's rule** (any ND stops the line; ND-4 and ND-5 the casualty above). The tower first: an act ahead of its command is v0.0.5's warning.

**The instinct** (`instinct/range.js`, the DI's lines on the KD): "Dial the coach's call: four up, two left.", "Your dope for three hundred is three down.", "Wind from the left: the coach says hold a mil left.", "Police your brass.", "Unused rounds back to the coach.", "Say it: no brass, no ammo.", and v0.0.6's rules unchanged on the bay.

**The far window** (`render/far.js`, `view.js`; VIEWS §2.4, TECH §9.9). The hud places it; the stage draws it:

The optic at 4× lifts the fog inside it (perception's reach × `OPTIC_FOG_K[4]` 4) and its field (the SO-4 at 4× about 6.5°, my call: a 4× sight's usual) is wider than the window at 300 m, so the field stays 4.9 m. **KD faces are drawn `FACE_K` 2 times life size** (VIEWS §2.12's card at 3×, my call): a 1.0 m A face 32 px, its black 10 px, a hole 1 px, the spotter disc 3 px, the score disk 10 px on its pole beside the face. Budget: +3 ms GPU, +60 draw calls (TECH §9.9).

### 2.5 hud

```js
placeFar(w, h, state, { bearingRad, rCss }) → { cx, cy, r, tickRad, slid }   // layout.js: on the frame's edge along the bearing,
  // inset 4 px, sliding along the edge to the nearest place free of every rectangle of `state` ('weapon', 'weapon-far'); the tick
  // on its ring along the true bearing; r = FAR_R_PX × the picture's scale in CSS px
STATES['weapon-far'] = weapon's less PAPER   // the far window placed against them; on the KD the face is in the window, so PAPER yields
```

**What the hud reads**: `stepsOf`, `stopNow`, `plaqueOf` (its `terms`, `kd`), `beliefOf` (`sight`, `zero`, `dope`, `optic`), `state.stop.hold`, `farPointOf`, `kdNow` (stages, groups, strings, pits, the coach's call, the relay's scores, brass, rounds, the declaration, the casualty, the summary), `readWind` through `kdNow.call` and the plaque (never `windAt`), `woundWords`, `avpuOf` (the screen's fade at P and U is the hud's), `earsOn`. **Truth never leaks** (§5.5's `ui-truth`): the turrets are seen; the zero, the wind and the range off a known line are beliefs.

**Sounds' inputs** (`src/data/sounds.js`, `src/ui/audio/range.js`): the `shot` fact (`who`, `muzzle`, `dirRad`, `load`, `flight.tofS`, `flight.rangeM`, `flight.supersonic`, `hole.onPaper`), the listener (the player's actor), `soundMsOf(envOfPlace(...))` (322 m/s on the range), `earsOn(state, playerId)`, the `pit` fact (a carrier at x, z going down or up), `say` kind `'pa'`. Your report at once; the crack of your round as it leaves (supersonic), then the strike back to you at `tofS + rangeM / c` (300 m: 0.42 + 0.93 s); a neighbour's report delayed by its distance, panned; reports merged within `REPORT_MERGE_MS` of each other and at most `REPORT_VOICES` at once; with ear defenders everything through `EARS_DB` and `EARS_LP_HZ`, the PA through them too.

### 2.7 The shared files, exactly

- **`src/sim/game.js`** (range): `SCENARIOS` gains `'test-range': testRange`, `SCENARIO_SITES` its site; the header's line. Nothing else.
- **`src/sim/arms/domain.js`** (range): `events` gains `'pit': onPitEvent`; the `actors` fast layer gains `gunnerStep`; `rules` calls range.js `safety` after `rangeRules` (which keeps test-handling's verdicts); `idFields` gains `'armoury.range.relay[].gunId': 'i'`, `'armoury.range.relay[].magIds[]': 'i'`.
- **`src/sim/body/domain.js`** (body): the slow contributor steps `stepWounds` for every person with injuries; `bodyFast` sets a casualty's stance; events gain nothing (hits come by call).
- **`tests/syntax.test.mjs`** (stage): `SIM_FOR_VIEW` gains `'src/sim/body/blood.js'`.
- **`src/data/activities.js`, `src/sim/time/activities.js`** (range, taken): the four records and their parts; no other record moves.
- **`src/sim/people/figure.js`** (stage, taken): `sit` and `down` to poses.
- **`handling.js`** (range, taken): the course engine reads its line, its lanes and its readinesses from the course; test-handling's path through it unchanged to the tick.

### 3.1 The fields

- **Gun**: `sight`, `zero`, `optic` (truth; absent: 0, 0 and 0, 0 and 1); `belief.zero` (absent: null, "the card's", read as the turrets' setting at issue). Integer clicks; nothing to round.
- **Item `ears`** (`kit.worn.ears`): a type with no fields but its model; `SLOTS` gains `'ears'`.
- **Body**: `parts` (a group in the templates, every part 0, saved as deltas, each rounded to 0.1 point), `blood` (a scalar, template 100, rounded to 0.01 %), `injuries` (carried whole when non-empty; each `{ part, kind, name, ms, until, bleed, rate, deep?, artery?, gunshot?, through?, internal?, cared? }`, ms integers, rates to 0.01), `knock` (`{ untilMs }` while down), `dead` (`{ ms, why }`). Absent: unhurt.
- **Stop**: `stop.hold` (`{ xMil, yMil }` in 0.25 mrad steps; absent centre).
- **Session** (`armoury.range` on the `kd` course): v0.0.6's keys and `kdLane, stage, line, groups, pits, call, reads, relay, relay2, staff, dummy, strings, brassTiles, policed, declared, casualty, limitAtMs`. `R.shots` keeps `SHOTS_KEPT` 100 (the player's and the relay's).
- **Issues** (`armoury.ammoIssues[]`): `+ line`, `+ back` (rounds turned in). One per line per shooter.
- **Places**: `places.sites[site].blood` (the body's list on PLACES's key, as `items[]` is the arms'): x, z to 0.01 m.

### 3.2 The upgrade (a v0.0.6 save loads)

**None is written** (v0.0.6's rule, BODY §2.5's "nothing is written on load"; my call, §8 item 14): every new field reads its default when absent: a v0.0.6 gun is zeroed on the BZO at 1× with its holder believing so; a v0.0.6 body is unhurt (`parts` from the template, `blood` 100, no injuries); a v0.0.6 session has no `kd` keys and plays test-handling. `tests/saves/` gains two saves **made by v0.0.6's own code** (a scratch worktree at tag v0.0.6, `git worktree add /private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r7/body/base-v0.0.6 v0.0.6`): `v0.0.6-barracks-1900.json.gz` and `v0.0.6-handling-hot.json.gz` (test-handling `setup=hot` after two shots); `game-upgrade` loads every save, plays 600 ticks, and re-saves each byte for byte where nothing ran (§5.2).

### 3.3 What a gunless game and test-handling change

- **A gunless game: nothing.** GOLDEN_SANDBOX, GOLDEN_ROSTER and game-domains' gunless digests unchanged; the wind is a pure function (no state); an unwounded body steps nothing new. **GROUND_AREA's golden is re-set on purpose** (the KD's pieces and walk rects), said in CHANGELOG.
- **test-handling: nothing a player sees.** Its course by the range bot on seed 48213 the same to the tick, the score, the coach's words and the save's 729 ids (`scene-handling`, `range-integration`, `range-nodead` green unchanged); `card25`'s holes by margin and hash as v0.0.5; no relay on the bay (§8 item 13); the SO-4 at 1×; no ear defenders; the A/W stance cycle unchanged. Its `shot` facts gain `flight` (an additive field).

## 5. Tests

Every test prints the numbers that matter, indented six spaces; names are sentences about the behaviour, with the user's words and date where a test pins their ask; assertions carry their evidence. A bound below that is my estimate rather than a section's number is a target: a role whose model disagrees prints its number, sets the bound to it with the reason, and says so in its report (never a test loosened silently).

### 5.1 ballistics

- **`ballistics`**: prints WEAPONS §2.4's tables (each class: v, E, flight time, path, drift per m/s at 100 to 600 m), §2.7's supersonic ranges, the bore-line lookup against direct integration in 5 random environments and zeroes (the worst path and drift error at 500 m), a lookup's cost in µs. Asserts: the valley at 300 m 657 m/s, 1,682 J (±2%), 0.42 s (±0.01), drift 3.7 cm per m/s (±0.2); an MCRN hull at 300 m 667 m/s (±2%); Earth at 300 m 607 m/s (±2%); Europa 790 m/s at every range; supersonic on the valley floor to 1,250 m (±5%); interpolation under 1 cm at 500 m; a lookup under 2 µs × k; no allocation per call after the first.
- **`zero`**: prints §2.5's table (the 400 m zero fired in each class), `DOPE_CARD`, `ZERO25_MARK_CM`, then 500 rifles drawn (`drawZero`) zeroed by a MRK 10 shooter on the zero card with the coach's calls: groups to zero (histogram), the residual at 300 m after the zero and after the confirm's calls. Asserts: the valley row −3, +12, +10, −20 at 25, 200, 300, 500 m (±2 cm); Europa +31 at 300 m (±2); the dope card ±1 click of those paths; ≥ 90% zeroed within 4 groups; the residual's sd at 300 m ≤ 15 cm after the zero and ≤ 6 cm after the confirm; a call moves the next group's mean by the clicks called (±0.3 click over 1,000 groups).
- **`wind`**: prints `windAt` over an hour at the 300 m line for seed 48213 (mean, min, max, the flags' lift), drift by speed and range, the read's error by MRK 6, 10, 14, 18 and with the coach (mean |error| / truth). Asserts: pure (the same arguments the same wind, no state written); drift linear in speed (±1%); the read's error within ±(1 − windCorr) every draw; the coach's call tighter than a MRK 10 read's.
- **`shot-distance`**: hit and score rates (a 5 or better, a scoring hit, mean points) at 200 and 300 m for prone, sitting, kneeling and standing at MRK 6, 10, 14, 18 over 2,000 shots a cell: in still air zeroed, with 4 m/s uncorrected, held for the read, held for the coach's call; the plaque against the true odds; **parity**: 1,000 shots at the 25 m card through v0.0.6's `holeOf` and through 0.0.7's path. Asserts: the card's holes identical to v0.0.6's (byte for byte); MRK 10 prone at 300 m, 4×, held, zeroed, still air: ≥ 70% a 5 or better; the wind uncorrected costs MRK 10 at 300 m at least 1.0 point a shot; the plaque equals `faceOdds` on the believed strike (±1 point); with the read equal to the truth and the zero known, the plaque equals the true rate (±3 points over 2,000).
- **`penetrate`**: prints §8.1's wound factors, §8.3's stop table for the soft panel and the plate at 10, 100, 300 m, §8.4's exits, §8.5's perforation table for ball and frangible, `holeArea` for every 6.5×40 load; **parity**: tradecraft's `layerHit` and blunt numbers for the same inputs, side by side. Asserts: R-7 ball w 1.61 at 10 m, 1.42 at 300 m (±0.03); the plate stops 6.5×40 ball 95, 97, 100% (±3); frangible through a pressure bulkhead 0%, ball 100%; the berm stops every round; paper never stops; `layerHit`'s shares equal tradecraft's.
- **`shot`** (updated): `biasMod`'s table −1, −2, −3, −5, −7, −9, −12 at 5 to 100 cm on a torso, exact.

### 5.2 body

- **`health`** (tradecraft parity): 12 hits (each part at force 0.3 and 0.7, w 1.5, the same seed) through tradecraft's `health.js` and `bullet()` (imported read-only from a scratch script; its numbers pasted into the test as data) and through `applyHit`: injuries, bleed rate, pain points and band, knock seconds, minutes to collapse (55) and to death (45), printed side by side. Asserts equal within rounding, but where BODY's changes say otherwise (a limb at 8 %/min, printed as such).

- **`nd-lands`**: 10,000 NDs per posture (slung front, low ready, aimed) × stance × during (up, magIn, charge, functionCheck) on the KD's 300 m line with the relay at 5 m and the coach at your left shoulder: into the berm, the ground, past, your foot, a neighbour, the coach; grades ND-1 to ND-5. Asserts: an aimed prone ND into the berm every time (ND-1); `SELF_SHOT_LONG` 10% (±1.5) on a long gun brought up or down; never a hit through the berm or the ground; ND-4 only with a body on the line.

**In node** (`node tests/run.mjs 'scene-range ›'`, then `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` green, under 60 s × k): the KD bot from the brief to the card on 48213 prints a zero in 1 to 4 groups, the confirm's five marks, the pits' splash, the 200 m string inside 60 s with the change, the dummy cleared, brass equal to rounds fired, the declaration accepted, the relay's six scores, a summary like "Clear at 10:31 · zero in 2 groups · 300 m 21 of 25 · 200 m 44 of 50 · 2 V · no faults". `scene-handling`, `range-nodead` and the walk unchanged; the goldens as §3.3 says.

**In the browser, by the keys** (`./play.sh --dev` is the user's; serve on 8236, `?play=test-range&seed=48213`, 1600 × 900, then 1024 × 768):

1. The brief on the PA through the ear defenders; the goal line; you prone on bay lane L with the relay of five on the bay, relay 2 not in sight. X, the step panel: LOAD, MAKE READY on the tower's word; the plaque on the zero card: "PAPER 95% | 25 M"; fire three. CEASE FIRE: the group card (three holes, the centre, "Ten up, four left"); the DI's line; the panel's "Dial the coach's call: 10 up, 4 left · 1.3 s"; dial; the turrets on the weapon card move; the next group closer; "Zeroed. Leave it."
2. UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR, police your brass (kneeling, the cases go), the unused rounds to the coach; the splash: the relay walking to the 300 m line; you prone on point 6 + L, the relay beside you, the flags along the range blowing.
3. "Optics to four power"; "Set your dope for three hundred" (3 down); bracket your target: **the far window opens** at the frame's edge on the face, 300 M, the reticle, the hold; the plaque gives the terms (300 m, the A target, wind ≈ 3 m/s from the left read, the coach's "hold half a mil right"); hold for the call; fire. The report, the crack, then the strike's thump; in the window the face drops, comes up with a spotter in the hole and the 4 on its pole. The relay's reports around you, their faces going down and up.
4. The coach's call after two marks; dial; five marks; CEASE FIRE; unload, police, turn in. The pits' splash ("Pits for relay 2 · 20 min": their scores in the strip); you sitting at the 200 m line.
5. Dope for 200 (6 down), LOAD five, MAKE READY, rapid: the clock on the panel, ten rounds, a magazine change inside the string (no fault), **the dummy clicks**: tap, rack, on; CEASE FIRE at the limit or the tenth; the targets marked together; the KD score card.
6. UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR; police; turn in; "No brass, no ammo?": declare; "The line is clear."; the end card ("Clear at …"), Score it: far window, shot at distance, range safety; Copy my scores gives the ROADMAP line.
7. Again with a new seed: aim uprange (the stop and the card), walk forward while hot (the stop), sit idle (the line moves on, the card at the end). In `?debug=1`, force an ND into a neighbour (`__olympus.range().nd('p31')`, the hud's handle): CEASE FIRE, the corpsman runs, kneels, the outcome splash, "The range is closed", the card with the incident.
8. The far window never covers a HUD rectangle at either size; nothing pops (carriers, flags, the relay walking, the splash's landing); `?bench=range-far` at 60 fps; Windows (`play.cmd --dev`) the same.

## 7. Not in this release

- **0.0.8**: the armoury window (draw by serial, the show clear under the armourer's eye, the weapons card), the range bus, the safety brief as a lived scene, the ammunition issue at the ASP and its count back as a walk, cleaning at the canopy, the armourer's inspection, `upkeep.js` (dust, fouling, heat moved by firing).
- **The qualification**: WEAPONS §11.1's six strings and the 500 m line's use (built, unused), the B target in a course, `qual.js`, the classes and the badge; the pits' mismarks and challenges, the puller's flinch; the player pulling butts lived.
- **0.1.x**: MARCH, the IFAK and the corpsman's steps, diagnosis, the lane (`test-lane`), the aid station as a place, healing by the day, infection, scars; armour worn on the range.
- **0.0.7b `test-pairs`** (COMBAT §25): the take-in (`takeInMs`), the shot rows (Pair, Hammer, Triple, Failure drill, To the head), drill rungs, turners; gunners reacting to threats.
- PLACES's weather (the wind here is the range's closed form), a dust front closing the range, tracers' grass fires, the HUD link's ballistic dot, lased ranges, spin habitats in play, free-fall brass drift.
- The relay on test-handling's bay (the user's scored scene stays as scored until they ask).

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the user's rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Five roles**: ballistics (the round in flight and on the paper), body (the wound model), range (the ground, the relay, the scene and its safety), stage (the picture and the far window), hud (the interface and the sound). The shared files have one owner each (§1).
2. **On a KD face and the zero card the bias moves the hole in centimetres; it is not a DC modifier** (WEAPONS §7.4 wrote it as `biasMod`, which cannot move a group, so zeroing could never be seen; the user's "you see it land"). The d20 decides the group's spread as tradecraft's does (the margin's ring band, by hash); the zero, the path, the wind and the hold move it in real units; the ring is scored where it lands. `biasMod` stays for people, with the character's corrections.
3. **`card25` keeps v0.0.5's hole by margin**, so test-handling's holes, scores and words are byte for byte (the user's 100/100/100). A rifle on the bay is treated as zeroed for the card.
4. **The plaque on a face gives the chance of a scoring hit on the believed strike**, a percentage on a known line when the wind read's band moves it under 10 points, else words (WEAPONS §7.10).
5. **The wind is a closed form of the seed, the sol, the time and the place**, no state, so lived and skipped agree and nothing saves; the day's mean 2 to 6 m/s at 10:00 (a morning breeze, under W §11.1's afternoon 0 to 8). PLACES's weather replaces it when it comes, with the same `windAt`.
6. **The wind and the hold are the player's choices on the character's read**: the read is the character's estimate by Marksmanship (W §7.4's `windCorr`), the coach's call tighter; the rows "Hold for your read" and "Hold for the coach" set the hold in one step, so a new player is never lost and an able one can do better.
7. **The zero is a turret setting**: the BZO stays W §2.5's 400 m on the valley floor (not a 300 m zero); clicks of 0.1 mrad; the rifle drawn off by N(0, 10) clicks (§4); the 25 m zero card prints the BZO's mark about 3 cm under the aim box; the confirm at 300 m is fired at the dope card's 3 down; the coach's calls after the confirm's marks move the believed zero.
8. **The SO-4's lever is a step**: 1× by default (test-handling unchanged), 4× on the KD at the tower's "Optics to four power" (+5 within 300 m, W §3.5).
9. **Sitting is a stance** (+3, W §7.3), offered by its own row and never in A and W's cycle.
10. **The relay is you and five of your platoon** on the bay's six lanes, then KD lanes 6 + bay lane (7 to 12), keeping their order; relay 2, six more, marks in the pits; one coach, yours.
11. **The 200 m string is two magazines of five with the change inside the string**, written into the course (`mags: 2`): the tower does not call the RELOAD and no `onemag` fault is drawn for the second magazine (the task's; W §11.1's 2 + 8 cut to 5 + 5 so the change comes mid-string).
12. **The pits mark truthfully this round and are lived at 300 m** (about 8 to 12 s a shot, seen in the far window); the rapid string is marked together after; mismarks and challenges wait for `qual.js`.
13. **test-handling keeps its empty line**: adding the relay there would change the scene the user scored.
14. **The wound model's state is additive and nothing is written on load**: `parts` and `blood` in the template, `injuries`, `knock`, `dead` carried when present; no upgrade function. Two v0.0.6 saves made by v0.0.6's code prove it.
15. **The casualty is lived to the edge, then an outcome**: the corpsman runs and works `CARE_EDGE_S` 20 s beside them in sight, his care a closed form (`careOf`), then the outcome splash over `EVAC_MIN` 12 min decides stabilised, evacuated or dead from the wound's numbers; the range closes after an ND-4 or ND-5 and the scene goes on to UNLOAD, SHOW CLEAR, the declaration and the card with the incident. The player as the casualty reaches the card through the splash.
16. **Through and through is penetrate.js's** (W §8.4's tissue against the round's pen), not tradecraft's `EXIT_P`; tradecraft's bleed, pain, knock and death stand, with BODY §17.1's changes.
17. **An ND's self-shot** is W §6.5's 0.1 for a long gun brought up or down, into the shooter's foot.
18. **Ear defenders** are a worn item (`kit.worn.ears`) issued with `range-kd` and worn the whole scene; the PA and everything else through them.
19. **Brass is policed at each line** before leaving it (the RO's "Police your brass"), and the declaration compares brass policed with rounds fired and rounds held with none; unused rounds go back to the coach on the line (the ammunition point's walk is 0.0.8's). A false declaration is a fault and the coach makes it right (never a dead end).
20. **The far window is placed by the hud and drawn by the stage** (`placeFar` → `view.setFar`), so the HUD's rectangles stay one module's; **KD faces are drawn twice life size** (`FACE_K` 2: the 25 m card's 3 would overlap the 5 m lanes).
21. **The KD ground is PLACES §4.12's**: lines at x 1,400, 1,300 and 1,100, faces at 1,600, the pits 1,600 to 1,610 behind a parapet 0.5 m over the floor, the berm 1,612 to 1,640 8 m high, flags every 100 m on both sides, zones `melas.kd-line-<n>`; the gates shut.
22. **The walks between lines are behind splashes** (the bay to the 300 m line ≈ 205 m, about 3 min at the walk, over TIME's 120 s, so an outcome; the pits and the walk to 200 m in one outcome), the relay and the coach placed at the next line behind it; the brass call lived where under 45 s.
23. **Gunners' rolls stay out of J**: the log is the player's; the relay's scores are on the card and their shots are facts with their `who`.
24. **The scene starts at 10:00** with the zero's issue in the pouches (four magazines of three); the 300 m and 200 m issues are given at the line behind the splashes, each its own ammunition issue line.
25. **The far window opens on E held too** on a KD line (your own face), as VIEWS §2.4 says; aim and bracket open it as well.
26. **The dummy is in the confirm's magazine or one of the 200 m's**, round 2 to 4, by weight; it clicks in a lived string, cleared by IMMEDIATE ACTION's steps; the coach says what it was after.
27. **No take-in, no rungs**: gunners answer the tower's commands, never threats; when `test-pairs` builds `takeInMs`, a gunner seeing a threat reads it.

**The fixer's resolutions (after the code, runtime and design reviews of v0.0.7)**, each (my call) unless a source is named:

28. **A face's height is the pits' record at the moment** (new `src/sim/arms/pits.js`: `pitView`, `faceUpAt`, `markedFor`, `FACE_DOWN_UP` 0.5), read by the shot, the relay and the ND's trace; a round at a face under half up goes into the berm, unmarked (item 12 holds: the pits mark truthfully, and only what reached the paper).
29. **Slow fire waits for the mark** (§2.3's "the wait for its mark"): a gunner's `mark` sub-step until its face is up with its last shot marked (`MARK_WAIT_MAX_MS` 30 s at most); the player's Fire is marked "! wait for your mark", never struck, with a `wait:mark` row of `MARK_WAIT_MS` 20 s that ends as the disk or the flag goes up; T does it.
30. **A gunner brings its rifle up before a handling step** (firearms.js `up`): doAction refuses one on a slung rifle, so the relay had loaded only inside the string.
31. **The player among an ND's hits is its casualty of record**, wherever they were on the round's line; the grade is the hits' (wounds.js `gradeOfHits`), said in an `nd` fact `during: 'graded'` when it moves.
32. **The casualty's outcome runs from the evacuation's start** (`C.evacAtMs`), and the card's blood is the body's at the splash's end.
33. **The coach's dummy is the coach's**: an issue counts its ball (`n`) and the dummy apart (`dummy: 1`); fired + back = n at the card. An ND's chambered round cleared by the coach goes back with the rest; a forced ND cycles the action as a real one does.
34. **At 200 and 300 m the shot's line is the roll and the shooter's own terms**; the pits and the coach say where it went (WEAPONS §1, §11.5). The zero card at 25 m keeps the hole in its line (seen at once in PAPER).
35. **The plaque's headline on a face is the chance of a five or a V** (`FIVE nn%`; item 4's chance of a scoring hit moves to the hover and `kd.scoreOdds`); words still replace it when the read's band moves even the chance on the paper 10 points.
36. **The coach's wind call is made at Marksmanship 14 at least** (wind.js `COACH_MRK_MIN`, through readWind's `mrkMin`), and the plate shows it in his whole metres a second; the reads are cleared at each new line.
37. **A row of four wind sleeves down the middle** (z 345, x 1,310, 1,410, 1,510, 1,595): in the picture on either line and in the far window (item 21's flags gain a middle row).
38. **A target past the frame leads at most `FAR_LEAD_M` 3 m** (render/lead.js): the far window is its frame (VIEWS §2.4).
39. **After a rapid string the far window holds on your face** until its holes have been up `FAR_MARK_HOLD_S` 6 s, and the coach reads the string whole.
40. **One map of a range rule's words** (handling.js `STOP_WORDS`) for the toast and the card; the card ranks the relay with you (kdNow's `relayLine`).
41. **The firing line's reach holds past the course's end** to the card (perception.js `lineBandOf`).

Left for the next round, with why: a gust in the player's own read of the flags (the design review's) contradicts WEAPONS §7.4 and §11's "gusts are not in it": the lead's call to change the section; the walk's and the pits' splashes (a walking part, the iris held on the old picture until the new line's chunks are up, the crops on the line ahead and the carriers) are the stage's and time's work, not a fixer's patch; turning in the unused rounds only at the course's end (item 19) changes the course's commands and is the lead's; the pullers under their carriers moves a place the ND's safety numbers stand on; the disk drawn on a visible pole wants a look at the far window's shots first.
